taxonomy.PHYSICAL_SINGLE_TOKEN: Source line has exactly one OCR/source token.
taxonomy.PHYSICAL_MULTI_TOKEN: Physical source line has multiple tokens and is not merely projected.
taxonomy.PROJECTED_FROM_MULTI_TOKEN: Gap candidate is projected from a source line with multiple tokens.
taxonomy.DETACHED_NUMERIC_FRAGMENT: Numeric fragment signal is the primary source-backed cause.
taxonomy.COMPOUND_FORM: Compound marker form is the primary source-backed cause.
taxonomy.LAYOUT_COLUMN_CORRUPTION: Page/column or OCR-block geometry is the primary cause.
taxonomy.NO_LOCAL_MARKER_EVIDENCE: No local marker evidence is present in the source neighborhood.
taxonomy.OTHER_SOURCE_BACKED: Source-backed cause not covered by the other classes.
taxonomy.UNRESOLVED: Insufficient source evidence for a narrower classification.
